name: delivery-canvas
description: A render surface: a Mermaid diagram viewer and a Markdown document viewer, shown live beside the files they were written from. Implements one surface capability group — render (render_diagram, render_markdown) — with push/replace navigation and a history the Back button walks, as an MCP server for hosts that speak MCP and as two canvases for hosts with a canvas panel, from one copy of each page. Tracks no runs and exports nothing; declares no dependency and names no engine.
